title: 皐月賞の後に・駆け込みの大舞台

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black runs in the Satsuki Sho and gives it her all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she spots reporters flocking to Brusquement after the race. It seems she still doesn't measure up to her rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the Classic Triple Crown is just getting started. Sakura Bakushin O gives her some much needed encouragement, and Kitasan Black is able to keep pushing forward.
